name: KaiokenTrain
title: Kaioken mastery trainer for CKMud
description: Trains kaioken mastery to the top: raises kaioken just above your mastery, drinks when thirsty, sleeps when fatigued, wakes when rested and stops once kaioken is mastered. Needs the MSDP package. Type `kt help`.
author: fried

aliases.name: kt
aliases.script:
if matches[2] == "update" then return CKMudUpdate("KaiokenTrain") end
local function arg(s) if s and s ~= "" then return s end end
kt.command(arg(matches[2]), arg(matches[3]))
